workflows.title: How to correct how a policy's sections were parsed
workflows.purpose: Fix mis-parsed section headings from an uploaded policy document, including reordering hierarchy or merging sections, applied for all future versions.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Policies
Click the row-actions button (ellipsis icon) for the policy whose sections need correcting
Click "Update sections" in the dropdown menu
In the "Update sections" dialog, tick the checkbox next to the section(s) that were parsed incorrectly
Optionally shift-click a further-down row to select every section in between
Click "Shift left" to promote the selected section(s) up a hierarchy level, or "Shift right" to demote them under the section above
Alternatively, click "Merge up" to fold the selected section(s) into the section immediately above them
Alternatively, hover a single row and click its inline chevron-left, chevron-right, or merge (up-arrow) icon to shift or merge just that one section
If needed, click "Undo" or "Redo" to step back and forth through the corrections made so far
Click "Save corrections" to persist the changes; they are kept with the policy and re-applied to every future version uploaded

workflows.title: How to file a new Form U5
workflows.purpose: Initiate and submit a Form U5 termination filing for an employee leaving the firm.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > U5 filings
Click "File New U5" to start a new filing
In "Select employee", search for and select the representative being terminated
In "Select firm", choose the firm filing the U5 (auto-filled if only one primary firm exists)
Click "Next: General information" to proceed to Step 2
Review the read-only Personal details (name, firm CRD, firm name, individual CRD) and Employment locations in Step 2
In "Section 3: Current residential address", confirm or update "Address line 1", "Start date", "City", "State", "Country", and "Zip code"
Click "Next: Termination information" to proceed to Step 3
Answer "Is this a full termination?" using the Yes/No control in Section 1: Termination details
If full termination, select the "Reason for termination" (Deceased, Discharged, Other, Permitted to resign, Voluntary)
Select the "Date terminated (MM/DD/YYYY)" using the date picker
Answer "Is this a multiple termination with one or more firms affiliated with the filing firm?" and select affiliated firms/registrations to terminate if applicable
Click "Next: Disclosures" to proceed to Step 4
Optionally check the "Disclosure certification checkbox" if there is no additional information to report, which hides sections 7A/7C/7D/7E
Expand each disclosure section (e.g. "7A. Investigation disclosure:") and answer Yes/No for every question, or click "Answer "No" to all" to bulk-clear a section
Click "Next: Disclosure reporting pages" to proceed to Step 5

Review all entered information under "Review and submit" (personal details, employment information, residential address, termination details, disclosures)
Click "Save and proceed to signatures" to create the filing record

In the Firm acknowledgment section, enter "Person to contact for further information", "Telephone # of person to contact", the signing date, and "Type or print name of appropriate signatory", then check the acknowledgment box and click "Sign firm acknowledgment"
In the Individual acknowledgment and consent section, confirm the printed name and signing date, check "Electronic signature of individual", then click "Sign individual acknowledgment"
Navigate to the filing detail page and click "Validate filing" to run FINRA validation
Once the filing status is "Ready to file" and all signatures are signed, click "File U5 to FINRA"
In the "Submit U5 filing" confirmation dialog, click "Submit filing" to finalize submission to FINRA

workflows.title: How to build and manage client-company relationships
workflows.purpose: Visualize the client/representative/account ownership graph and draw new relationship edges between entities.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Company structure (this view is not linked from the sidebar tabs — go directly to the URL /account-surveillance/company_structure).
Wait for the relationship graph to load. A spinner labeled "Loading relationship data..." displays until the client/representative/account ownership graph is fetched.

Review the rendered graph titled "Client Relationship Builder". Nodes are laid out by type (COMPANY at the root, then CLIENT, REPRESENTATIVE, and ACCOUNT nodes), with existing edges labeled by relationship (e.g. "OWNS", "MANAGES").
Use the graph's zoom/fit controls (bottom-left "Controls" widget rendered by ReactFlow) to position the source and target nodes you want to connect.
Click and drag from the connection handle on the source node to the connection handle on the target node to draw a new relationship edge between them.

Releasing the drag immediately submits the new relationship — there is no confirmation dialog. The edge is created via a request carrying only the source and target node IDs; the backend assigns the relationship type/label.
Observe the "Creating relationship..." indicator in the bottom-right corner while the new edge is saved; the new edge also appears immediately on the graph as an optimistic update.

Once the request completes, the graph refetches from the backend (via the relationships endpoint) and replaces the optimistic edge with the permanent, saved relationship — no further save/confirm action is required.
